title: Tiny, cute teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#c98a4b'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#e8b57a'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#b3733a'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#b3733a'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#efc9a0'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#efc9a0'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(20 26 66)'/>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(-20 74 66)'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='32' cy='27' r='10' fill='#c98a4b'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='27' r='10' fill='#c98a4b'/>
    <circle cx='32' cy='27' r='5' fill='#f2a9b6'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='27' r='5' fill='#f2a9b6'/>

    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#d99a5b'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#f7d9b0'/>

    <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3a2417'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3a2417'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='1' fill='#fdf3e0'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='1' fill='#fdf3e0'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='2.6' fill='#4a2c1a'/>
    <path d='M50 47 L50 51 M50 51 q-4 3 -7 0 M50 51 q4 3 7 0' stroke='#8a5a33' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- bow -->
    <path d='M50 58 l-8 -5 v10 z' fill='#e0524f'/>
    <path d='M50 58 l8 -5 v10 z' fill='#e0524f'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='2.6' fill='#f07a77'/>
